correctness.rationale: Both endpoint evaluation operators reproduce constants. Integrating the Legendre Christoffel–Darboux endpoint kernel gives (P_n+P_(n+1))/2 and integrated Chebyshev Dirichlet kernel yields [(pi-u)-2 Σ_(k<=n)sin(ku)/k]/pi. A Lipschitz function has arbitrary a.e. derivative with |f′|<=1, and taking its sign equal to either integrated kernel attains the exact L1 norm for every n including n=0. The Jacobi contiguous identity P_n+P_(n+1)=(1+x)P_n^(0,1) and global Darboux bound plus oscillatory averaging produce sqrt(n) E_L -> sqrt(2/pi); Abel expansion of the sine-series tail, controlled splitting near u=0, yields n E_C -> 8/pi². Independent quadrature computed n=0,1,2,5,10,30,100 and confirmed e.g. E_L(n=2)=24sqrt(6)/125 and scaled values at n=100 0.79392049,0.80188568 near respective constants 0.79788456,0.81056947. Finite numerical results are only corroboration of analytic asymptotics.
